QuestInfo.name: Herb Town Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Ku in Herb Town is well advanced in years. Listen to how he goes through the winter.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Ku in Herb Town is known for staying healthy through the winter despite his old age. They say that the secret to his health has something to do with the Yellow Bellflower Bud... The Yellow Bellflower Bud is very rare and can only be found during the winter. Help Mr. Ku by getting Yellow Bellflower Buds.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered Yellow Bellflower Buds for Mr. Ku. The Yellow Bellflower Bud has amazing healing effects. It would certainly be a hot seller if you could only collect a massive amount of it...

0.0: Tsk tsk. Why's a youngster like you hunch your shoulders like that? Tsk! Too delicate! You should try taking some Yellow Bellflower Bud.\r\n#L0##bYellow Bellflower Bud?#l\n#k
0.1: Yes. The Yellow Bellflower Bud can only be found during winter. It's good for your immune system. I took it since I was young and that's the secret to my health. I never get sick during winter, not even once! I'm planning on harvesting some this year, but I'm short of hands.  Please help.

yes.0: Go harvest #e#b20 Yellow Bellflower Buds#k#n from the Bellflower farm. I don't care what kinds of Bellflowers you pick. The buds can be found on old Bellflowers as well. The Red-Nose Pirates and Alligators may have them as well. They probably stole them from the Bellflower farm. Hurry up! \n\n#b#i4032572# #t4032572# x 20
